latestVersion.changelog:
douyin-automation 1.0.0

- Initial release supporting automated login, upload, and video publishing on Douyin Creator Platform using Puppeteer.
- Provides command-line scripts for login, video upload (with title, description, tags), and login management (check, view, clear credentials).
- Secure local storage of Douyin login credentials and browser session data; no external servers accessed.
- SMS verification required on first upload after login; subsequent uploads fully automated.
- Supports macOS, Linux, and Windows environments.
